item.title: 02.Building Effective Agents
item.author: chengxue.han654@gmail.com (Hassenfeld)
item.description: This article explores practical patterns for building effective LLM agents. It distinguishes between predefined workflows and autonomous agents, detailing common patterns such as prompt chaining, routing, parallelization, and the evaluator-optimizer loop, while emphasizing simplicity and transparency as core design principles.

item.title: 01.Introducing Contextual Retrieval
item.author: chengxue.han654@gmail.com (Hassenfeld)
item.description: Introduces Contextual Retrieval, a method to significantly improve RAG accuracy by up to 67% by maintaining document context within individual chunks using Contextual Embeddings and Contextual BM25.
